apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
New
- Single songs: with slskd connected (Settings → Connections), Tuna gets one song instead of its whole album. slskd finds it on Soulseek and downloads just that file, and Lidarr files it into its album and keeps track of it like everything else (the album stays unwatched). - Greyed songs in playlists and Liked songs, songs in search and each song on an album page have their own small Get; once the song is here, it turns into the round arrow that keeps it on the device (in the apps). - Get the missing songs and Get all ask for the songs themselves, most played first, four at a time. Without slskd, their albums, as before.
- Songs you don't have, in search: after the library's songs, songs from all music, each with Get.
- New songs every Monday: each person gets songs they don't have (ListenBrainz's suggestions and songs like the ones they play most), first in their Fresh catch, which is Home's big card while there are some. Songs nobody likes or adds to a playlist go the next week. An admin sets how many in Settings → Weekly picks.
- Song radio finds new songs: a few songs like it that aren't here join it as they arrive.

Changed
- iPhone: tapping a text box no longer zooms the page in (which pushed the tabs off the screen), and text on phones is sized as in Netfish.
- On its way shows songs too, with their progress; albums taken out of Lidarr leave it.
- The opening animation always ends on the logo, and the empty-list fish shows on coloured backgrounds.

To update: the server (pull the new image); the apps don't need updating. For single songs, add
slskd's address and API key in Settings → Connections; its downloads folder has to be visible to
Lidarr (docs/install/server.md).
